description: This file defines the ReadableCustomerAttribute class, which extends CustomerAttributeEntity, adding readable properties for customer options and values in a customer attribute context.

classes.name: ReadableCustomerAttribute
classes.description: A class representing a customer attribute with readable options and values, extending CustomerAttributeEntity.

methods.name: setCustomerOption
methods.description: Sets the customer option associated with this attribute.

methods.name: getCustomerOption
methods.description: Returns the customer option associated with this attribute.

methods.name: setCustomerOptionValue
methods.description: Sets the customer option value associated with this attribute.

methods.name: getCustomerOptionValue
methods.description: Returns the customer option value associated with this attribute.
